description: This file defines a custom controller convention implementation for ASP.NET Core MVC, specifically a convention to group API controllers by API version based on route attributes.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: Implements IControllerModelConvention to modify controller models by setting their ApiExplorer.GroupName based on route template to enable API version grouping.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Modifies the provided ControllerModel to set its API explorer group name according to the route attribute's template, establishing version-based grouping.
